Each class keeps a private `Map` of snapshots, writes with the entity's `toSnapshot()` and reads back with the entity's `restore(...)`. Neither class hands out a stored object directly or works around that conversion. Each one implements its own port interface. The only entity-specific logic is `findByStatus` in the order repository, which filters on the stored snapshot's `status` field. That logic exists only there, so no domain rule is copied. The two classes share the same `Map`-plus-snapshot code, which could be pulled into a generic base. That is ordinary repeated code in a small adapter, not a repeated business rule or invariant, so it does not justify a fail. Import direction (the imports come from `application/ports/persistence`, while the graph points at domain files) is out of scope.
